events.headline: The Clay Skills Marketplace Is Open
events.summary: Clay launched a community marketplace for skills that are free to install and run in Claude Code, Codex, or Cursor.

events.headline: Clay adds 24 new and updated integrations
events.summary: Clay added 24 integrations covering EMEA and APAC data, new industries and buying signals, enrichment, dialers, CRMs, and warehouses.

events.headline: Clay previews and launches products at Sculpt 2026
events.summary: Clay's Sculpt recap says it launched a new agentic way to build in Clay, Clay Workflows, and an Inbound SDR Agent as part of its self-learning revenue engine.

events.headline: Claygent makes auto-mode the default
events.summary: Clay made auto-mode the default setting for Claygent, routing each task to an appropriate model; Clay reported production costs 47% lower than always using its most capable model while maintaining frontier quality.
